title: Standalone fixed-city discovery-only Search v1 JSON interchange structures
description: Closed scenario, envelope, receipt, state and trace with API result definitions. Authored statically; not executed or schema-validated. Shape does not establish calculation, historical reachability, native fidelity or authenticity. Runtime additionally rejects non-own/accessor/inherited/symbol properties, negative zero, unsafe integers, duplicate decoded JSON keys, noncanonical saved genesis, invalid references and derived-state mismatches. Every complete input/result/save has 16MiB UTF-8, 1048576 nodes, depth24, array4096 and object128-key limits; the escaped SaveResult and all old idempotent returns are included. Individual maxima share these budgets and are not necessarily jointly attainable. Only O13-A is implemented; O13-B is not accepted. Object APIs support only non-Proxy plain/null-prototype own-data JSON DTOs; reflection may trigger Proxy traps, and hostile Proxy or polluted runtime are unsupported rather than guaranteed detectable. JSON-string load has a separate bounded parser. Full reconstruction and repeated history/receipt budget scans grow at least quadratically in history; 4096 is a hard limit, not a latency or benchmark guarantee.

policy.description: Only the complete registered city-search-policy-v1 value is accepted. A future policy requires a different profile/version and new genesis, never an ID-only override.

scenario.description: Runtime additionally enforces force/corps references, balance <= capacity, unique actor+talent IDs and unique treasure instance IDs, actedTurn <= initial turn, appearance <= horizon end, safe turn+advanceLimit, and the complete calendar horizon. Create canonicalizes raw pool order by ASCII ID. There is no automatic treasure catalog import or authenticity certification.

snapshot.description: Registries, sorted by ASCII ID, are authoritative runtime discovery state. Raw genesis discovered flags stay immutable. IDs, chronological metadata, counts and every derived scalar are verified by replay, not merely shape.

const.scope: resolved stable inputs; filtered-candidate numerical baseline only

talentKernel.description: Unchanged published kernel receipt in this service's <=1024 filtered-candidate domain; returnedEax205 is preserved. Embedded historical evidence true flags do not claim a new validation run.

const.scope: already selected candidate; stable resolved uint8 value; pre-RNG roll argument only
post-RNG caller arithmetic from explicit per-call uint32 captures; no helper or reward execution

goldKernel.description: Published full-U32 kernel is unchanged. This receipt shape is restricted to this service's stable 0..1e9 city/cap and 0..255 RNG domain; second read values equal the first pair exactly when required, enforced by recomputation. Other old-API U32 results are not service receipts.

credit.description: before/after plus requested, actual and discarded; actual=min(requested, cap-before), discarded=requested-actual. Field-specific caps and exact requests are enforced by runtime.

receipt.description: Complete derived accepted-command receipt, including paid nothing. Kernel evidence is preserved; service mapping and writers retain separate evidence labels. Load/replay compare the whole value. No complete genesis is copied per receipt.

state.description: Complete persisted state. Runtime rebuilds canonical genesis and each unique accepted envelope, compares full receipts and final snapshot, and enforces save and complete return budgets at every step. Every new state reserves return capacity for all original accepted idempotent receipts, including receipts larger/deeper than the newest one. Self-consistency is not cryptographic authenticity; a coherently rewritten genesis/history is a different supplied scenario.

failure.description: No committed state or receipt; failures preserve caller state and RNG. index identifies a failing history/trace entry if available. A paid nothing outcome is an accepted receipt, not this failure shape.

commandSuccess.description: New accepted command: committed=true/duplicate=false. Exact accepted envelope retry: committed=false/duplicate=true, original receipt and current state. Retry is recognized before stale revision checks.

previewSuccess.description: Does not commit or reserve ID/RNG/resources. Uses the same command/save/all-old-retry gate and full preview budget. Duplicate preview returns original receipt and current snapshot.

json.description: Canonical full state JSON. 16MiB applies to the full escaped SaveResult UTF-8 serialization, not merely this inner string; UTF-8 and object budgets are runtime obligations.

trace.description: Null expectedOutcome or expectedFinalSnapshot disables that comparison only; actual qualification, selection, RNG and results are still computed. Typed interchange includes valid-envelope failures and retries. Runtime defensive recording of malformed envelopes is outside this typed envelope schema.
